summary: Write u₀⁻¹gu₀ = inclGL(k) with the last row of k̄ equal to e; reindex the Gauss sum by y ↦ k̄y and check each term with the hypothesis h.

steps.claim: Since g and g⁻¹ lie in mirabolic, 𝐛_e(g) ≠ 0 and 𝐛_e(g⁻¹) ≠ 0, so 𝐞(u₀⁻¹gu₀) ≠ 0 and 𝐞((u₀⁻¹gu₀)⁻¹) ≠ 0 (lastRowDatum_conj_u₀); by exists_inclGL_eq, u₀⁻¹gu₀ = inclGL(k) (r) for some k ∈ GL_{n+1}(O) whose reduction k̄ has last row e (c).
steps.lean:
have ⟨k, c, r⟩ := exists_inclGL_eq (g :=
    _ * g * _) ((lastRowDatum_conj_u₀ _).trans_ne (lastColDatum_ne_zero G))
    (by simpa using (lastRowDatum_conj_u₀ _).trans_ne (lastColDatum_ne_zero (inv_mem G)))

steps.claim: Unfolding F = π(u₀)∑_y psiN(y_last)π(κ_y), the claim becomes an equality of two sums over the vectors y with unit last entry.

Reindex by the bijection y ↦ k̄·y of these vectors (it fixes the last entry, as the last row of k̄ is e). Termwise: with a = (κ_{k̄y})⁻¹·u₀⁻¹ and b = u₀·κ_y (up to the conventions of the source), a·g·b = (κ_{k̄y})⁻¹·k·κ_y lies in mirabolic, because its reduction sends e to e (k(·) has last column the given vector); so by h, π(a)(T(π(b)φ)) = φ, which is the termwise identity.
steps.lean:
use sum_equiv (toPerm (reductionGL k)) (by simp [c]) fun y a ↦ congrArg₂ _ (by simp [c])
    (π.ρ.inv_apply_eq_iff.1 (h _ _ ⟨(liftGL (exists_GL_last_col_and_row.choose
    (reductionGL k • y)))⁻¹ * k * liftGL (exists_GL_last_col_and_row.choose y), by
    simp [inv_smul_eq_iff, -Units.smul_def, surjInv_eq,
      ← smul_smul]; simp_all [exists_GL_last_col_and_row.choose_spec], by simp [r, mul_assoc]⟩))
